callees.name: _has_source_code
callees.pre_condition: proj_dir is an existing directory. submodules is either None or a list of relative subdirectory path strings.
callees.post_condition: Returns true when the filtered source tree contains at least one file with a recognized extension; returns false otherwise.

callees.name: load_call_edges
callees.pre_condition: extra_call_edges_path is either None or a string path to an existing JSON file containing supplemental call edge definitions.
callees.post_condition: Returns a list of supplemental CallEdge records parsed from the JSON file at extra_call_edges_path. Returns an empty list when extra_call_edges_path is None or the file does not exist.

callees.name: _clean_previous_run
callees.pre_condition: work_dir is a filesystem path string.
callees.post_condition: The directory at work_dir has been removed from the filesystem along with all its contents.

callees.name: stage_domain_knowledge_files
callees.pre_condition: proj_dir and work_dir are existing directory paths. domain_knowledge_files is either None or a list of paths to existing markdown files.
callees.post_condition: Returns a list of relative paths under the workspace to the staged markdown files. Each file has been copied into a location under the workspace.

callees.name: _run_generate_phases
callees.signature: _run_generate_phases(proj_dir, work_dir, script_dir, resume, submodules, plugin_stage, plugin_root)
callees.pre_condition: proj_dir and work_dir are existing directory paths.
callees.post_condition: A phases.json file has been written to work_dir describing the dependency-ordered phase plan for the source files in scope.

callees.name: _post_process_phases
callees.pre_condition: work_dir contains a valid phases.json file generated by the phase planning stage.
callees.post_condition: The phases.json at work_dir has been mutated to: force-include every path in required_source_files (if provided), restrict scope to submodules (if provided), and collapse into a single phase (if one_phase is true). Returns true when phases.json was modified; returns false when it was left unchanged.

callees.name: _run_generate_domain_context
callees.pre_condition: proj_dir and work_dir are existing directory paths. work_dir contains a phases.json file.
callees.post_condition: Domain context files describing the project's type system and architecture have been written under work_dir.

callees.name: try_codegraph_init
callees.post_condition: When the codegraph tool is installed, a SQLite index of the source tree at proj_dir has been built or rebuilt if force is true. When codegraph is not installed, returns without error.

callees.name: run_extraction
callees.pre_condition: proj_dir is an existing directory containing source files. work_dir is an existing directory.
callees.post_condition: For every function in the filtered source tree, an extracted source file has been written under extracted_functions/ within work_dir. When force is true, all files are re-extracted; when force is false, only the extracted files whose corresponding source has changed are re-extracted.

callees.name: collect_file_names
callees.pre_condition: input_dir is an existing directory path.
callees.post_condition: Returns a list of relative file paths to all extracted function source files found under input_dir. Writes the same list to file_list_path for caching.

callees.name: generate_topdown_layers
callees.pre_condition: work_dir is an existing directory containing extracted function files.
callees.post_condition: Topdown dependency layer metadata files have been written under work_dir. These layers define a total ordering where every callee of a function belongs to an earlier layer, ensuring that callees are processed before their callers.

callees.name: run_spec_generation_and_verification
callees.signature: run_spec_generation_and_verification(proj_dir, work_dir, input_dir, output_dir, script_dir, spec_prompts_dir, phases_data, resume, extra_call_edges, only_spec, bug_validator_path)
callees.pre_condition: work_dir contains phases.json, extracted function files, domain context files, and topdown layer metadata files. input_dir points to the extracted_functions/ directory.
callees.post_condition: For every function in the layer plan, .spec.json and .info.json behavioral specification sidecars have been written next to the corresponding extracted source file. When only_spec is false, verification verdict JSON files have been written under output_dir (logic_verification_results/) and bug validation reports have been written under bug_validation/ with an aggregate summary.json aggregating confirmed and not-confirmed bug counts.
